NA.label: NA
definitions: None of other codes are applicable.

ethical-reasoning.label: ethical-reasoning
definitions: The item contains reasoning that invokes moral principles, ethical considerations, humanitarian concerns, or value judgments about right and wrong that go beyond pure in-game strategic calculus. For example, explicit references to ethical principles, civilian harm, proportionality of violence, nuclear taboos, or statements framing actions as morally good or bad.

strategic-reasoning.label: strategic-reasoning
definitions: The item contains reasoning focused on game mechanics and winning WITHOUT ethical or moral framing present. For example, in-game strategic advantage, military calculations, resource optimization, diplomatic maneuvering, victory path analysis, or cost-benefit evaluation.
